feature: ai-git-cleanup v2: one gate, fetch status, post-cleanup sync
gating: Run layers in order. Do not run a layer until every case in the layer before it passes.

unit.case: fetchStatus: `ok` after a successful fetch with a working origin — exact value, own top-level property, stdout still one single JSON document (R2)
fetchStatus: `ok` with no origin — best-effort fetch skipped, run exits 0, field present with exact value (R3 configuration: absent remote)

fetchStatus: `failed: <first stderr line, trimmed>` with a broken origin — exact prefix and actionable reason, stdout uncorrupted single JSON (JSON.parse of whole stdout succeeds), and classification stays conservative (fallback default path, no fabricated delete candidates)

single-view payload completeness (R2): every deleteCandidate carries its exact `command` (`git branch -d '<branch>'`) and `verifyWith` guard, every stale worktree carries its exact `git worktree remove '<path>'` command, candidate worktreePath equals the worktree entry path (L14 back-link), fetchStatus top-level — everything the one gate view renders comes from the report, not prose
regression: the 16 pre-existing analyze.spec cases stay green with fetchStatus added (additive top-level field, no whole-document equality exists)

postSync.prune field-presence conditional (R3): exact `git worktree prune` present only when a worktree removal is queued; absent in a fixture with no removal — fetchStatus still present in the same document (R2)

postSync.pull field-presence conditional (R3): exact `git pull --ff-only` command with upstream name and behind count present only when the default branch is behind its upstream; absent when level or ahead
ahead default branch is report-only: ahead count emitted, postSync.pull absent, and no `push` substring in ANY command field of the emitted document (scan every command-bearing field, R3 invariant)

flow command plan (existing case, CHANGED): every emitted command single-quoted with an ancestry guard before each `git branch -d`, no protected/current/default deleted, postSync commands now included in the scan, and no `push` in any emitted command

flow pairing contract (existing case, CHANGED — U16): every queued worktree removal precedes its branch delete with the candidate↔worktree back-link intact under the merged single-plan format; dirty refusal outranks ordering; fetchStatus and postSync present in the same document
flow unanalyzed bucket surfaces in the emitted plan (existing case, STAYS)

cli.case: no-origin CLI run exits 0 with a single JSON document and fetchStatus exactly `ok` (existing case, CHANGED — extended)

broken-origin CLI run: fetchStatus `failed: <reason>` surfaced with an actionable first stderr line, stdout not corrupted (whole stdout parses as one JSON doc), conservative fallback/derivation intact (existing case, CHANGED — extended)
regression: the other 4 cli.spec cases stay green (explicit path, cwd, origin/HEAD default, non-repo exit); gate-2 comments updated for truthfulness, no assertion change
